title: picramnia guianensis
intro: Picramnia guianensis, commonly known as Quassia, is a plant species belonging to the family Simaroubaceae. The health benefits of Picramnia guianensis include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anthelmintic, antimalarial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in the treatment of parasitic infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Picramnia guianensis include quassin, quassinoid compounds, and other triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
